items.headline: Singaporean, 60, dies during descent from Mount Everest
items.summary: Liew Shuik Chin, a 60-year-old Singaporean known as Jason, collapsed and died on 15 November while descending in the Everest region of Nepal; his body has been returned to his family.

items.headline: Singapore to grant a one-off property tax rebate of up to 15% in 2027
items.summary: The Finance Ministry and IRAS will give a one-off rebate on 2027 property tax bills: 15% for owner-occupied HDB flats and 10% (capped at S$100) for owner-occupied private homes, due by 31 January 2027.

items.headline: Singapore pushes AI across its financial system to help knit an ASEAN digital economy
items.summary: MAS's drive to embed AI across the financial system could help build a more connected South-east Asian digital economy, following the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement expected to take effect early next year.

items.headline: World Court finds Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
items.summary: The ICJ ruled nine votes to six that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya in 2016-2017, its first finding of state responsibility for genocide, ordering prevention, prosecutions and a report within two years.

items.headline: Attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz hit their highest level since the Iran war began
items.summary: At least 22 attacks on shipping were reported in the Strait of Hormuz in November, the second-highest monthly total of the Iran war, with two more tankers struck on 22 November; transits remain about 65% below pre-war levels.

items.headline: Update: Israeli strike kills a UN aid worker in Gaza as the ceasefire frays
items.summary: An Israeli strike killed a UNRWA worker on 23 November and a separate strike killed two more in western Gaza City, as the US warned the fragile October 2025 ceasefire could collapse amid strikes beyond the 'yellow line'.

items.headline: Nvidia-backed Genesis AI raises $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation
items.summary: French robotics startup Genesis AI raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation, co-led by Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures and Eclipse with Nvidia participating, amid a surge of investment into physical-AI and robotics.

items.headline: AI finance startup Model ML raises $250 million at a $1.5 billion valuation
items.summary: Model ML, which builds AI agents for bankers, consultants and investors, raised $250 million at a $1.5 billion valuation, co-led by General Atlantic and QED Investors.

items.headline: Wall Street posts its best day since April 2025 as Nvidia rebounds
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 4.7% and the Nasdaq Composite surged 6.5% on 23 November, their best day since April 2025, ending a seven-day losing streak after a week that had cut the S&P 500 by 8.6%; Nvidia led with a 31% gain.

items.headline: Update: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and the stock jumps 31%
items.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned amid a China espionage scandal; the stock jumped about 31% to roughly $165 after President Trump said he pressed the board to act.

items.headline: CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler for about $44 billion
items.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valuing it at about $43.9 billion, its largest acquisition; Zscaler rose about 18% and CrowdStrike fell about 8%, with closing expected in H2 of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.

items.headline: Update: India held to a draw in the Wellington Test as New Zealand's lower order resists
items.summary: The first Test drew after Daryl Mitchell and Glenn Phillips batted out the final day, leaving New Zealand 239-5 replying to India's 720-9 declared; Henry Nicholls (175 not out) was player of the match, series level 0-0.

items.headline: Verstappen eyes the runner-up spot as F1 heads to the Qatar Grand Prix
items.summary: With Kimi Antonelli already champion and Mercedes constructors' winners, Max Verstappen heads to the Qatar GP on 29 November leading the fight for second, 40 points clear of George Russell after his Las Vegas win; two rounds remain.

items.headline: Homo erectus survived in southern China's rainforests until 184,000 years ago
items.summary: Two Nature studies report Homo erectus persisted in southern China's tropical rainforests as recently as 184,000 years ago, far later and in a wetter habitat than assumed, based on eight teeth from caves in Guangxi.

items.headline: A Neanderthal gene variant may shrink part of the brain and lower schizophrenia risk
items.summary: A study by Hugo Zeberg and Svante Paabo found a Neanderthal-inherited variant near the DAAM1 gene is linked to a slightly smaller occipital lobe and, in people with two copies, a nearly 10% lower schizophrenia risk.

items.headline: A study warns a million orbital data centres could sharply pollute the upper atmosphere
items.summary: Researchers estimate a proposed constellation of about a million orbital data-centre satellites could raise upper-atmosphere pollution more than 100-fold via launches and re-entries, with possible ozone and climate effects.

fun_fact.headline: The word 'robot' was coined for a 1920 Czech play, not by engineers.
fun_fact.body: The word 'robot' was introduced in Karel Capek's 1920 Czech play R.U.R. (Rossum's Universal Robots); Capek credited his brother Josef with coining it, from the Czech 'robota', meaning forced labour or drudgery. The play's robots are artificial people, closer to today's androids than to industrial machines.

puzzle.title: Wine and Water
puzzle.body: Equal glasses of wine and water. Move a teaspoon of wine into the water and mix, then a teaspoon of the mixture back into the wine. Is there more wine in the water or water in the wine?
puzzle.approach: Track what must be true once both glasses hold their original amount again.
puzzle.answer: They are exactly equal. Each glass ends with its original volume, so the wine missing from the wine glass is exactly replaced by water, and that wine now sits in the water glass; the two amounts match regardless of spoon size or mixing.

word_puzzle.title: Brushstrokes
word_puzzle.body: Spelling Bee. Centre letter T; outer letters P, A, I, N, E, R. Make 4+ letter words that all use T; find the 7-letter pangram.
word_puzzle.approach: Every word must contain the centre letter T; the pangram is a kind of artist.
word_puzzle.answer: Pangram PAINTER (also REPAINT). Sample words: PAINT, PRINT, TRAIN, TAPIR, TAPER, RATE, TEAR, RANT, PANT, PINT, IRATE, TRIPE, INERT, INTER, RETAIN, RETINA, TREAT, ATTAIN, ENTRAP, PERTAIN, TERRAIN, NITRATE.
